newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-TWINS PLACE TEWKSBURY ON DISABLED LIST.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-TWINS PLACE TEWKSBURY ON DISABLED LIST.

text.p: The Minnesota Twins placed pitcher Bob Tewksbury on the 15-day disabled list on Thursday, retroactive to May 5, with a cut right middle finger.

The 36-year-old righthander injured his finger after getting it caught in a door on a team bus during the Twins last road trip. Tewksbury last pitched on May 4 and allowed just four hits in a 1-0 loss at Toronto.
He is eligible to come off the disabled list on May 20.
Tewksbury, who signed as a free agent with the Twins in the off-season, is 1-5 with a 3.35 ERA in seven starts with two complete games and one shutout this season.
One of baseball's top control pitchers, Tewksbury is the active leader in fewest walks issued per nine innings (1.46).
